title: init_db() runs as an import-time side effect
evidence: app.py:156 calls init_db() at module top level, so importing app creates books.db on disk
suggestion: Gate DB initialization behind create_app()/__main__ so importing the module (e.g. in tests) has no filesystem side effect

title: No dependency manifest (requirements.txt / pyproject.toml)
evidence: run dir has only app.py, README.md, tests/; README instructs 'pip install flask' manually
suggestion: Add a requirements.txt pinning flask so the environment is reproducible

title: ?author= filter uses exact-match equality
evidence: app.py:84 'SELECT * FROM books WHERE author = ?' matches the full author string exactly (case-sensitive, no partial match)
suggestion: Acceptable per spec; a LIKE/substring match would be more forgiving but is not required
